about: The only place a GoIDEA status is raised in OPENIDEA_PARITY_MATRIX.md. Keys are kind:id; a non-missing status must carry evidence (a regression check id from REGRESSION_INDEX.json, a document, or a source path). Everything absent here is reported as missing. Start conservative: `partial` when only part of the OpenIDEA surface is proven, `integrated` when a gate check exercises it.
